usage: soil_saturation_ratio = GWETROOT directly per SRS.md Section 10.1. No conversion formula. Label as 'soil saturation proxy' in all UI components.

locations.label: soil saturation proxy
locations.source: NASA POWER GWETROOT (~50km native resolution — external-data-only estimate)
locations.resolution_note: NASA POWER native resolution is ~50km (MERRA-2 grid). This is a known, permanent accuracy ceiling per SRS.md Section 8. All pilot hexes receive the same nearest-grid value — not village-level data.
